PasswordSignIn.headerSub: Sign in with email and password

ResetPassword.descriptionKey: Enter your email address and the reset key provided by your administrator. The key can be used once and is valid for 7 days.
ResetPassword.descriptionPassword: Use at least 6 characters and follow your organization’s password requirements.
ResetPassword.errorPassword: The password must contain at least 6 characters.
ResetPassword.errorReset: The password could not be changed. Check your email address, key and password requirements. Expired or previously used keys are invalid.
ResetPassword.descriptionSuccess: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in with your new password.
